Author Biographies Dr. Sharik Ahmad received his Ph.D. in Computer Science and is currently pursuing a second Ph.D. at Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, India. His research interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Multimodal Learning, Healthcare Analytics, Language Models, Science. published several research papers in SCI, Scopus, and Web of Science indexed journals and conferences. Prof. Rafat Parveen is a Professor in the Department of Computer Science at Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, India. Her research focuses on Bioinformatics, Machine Learning, Cloud Security, and Computational Systems Biology. She has published extensively in reputed journals conferences supervised numerous Ph.D. scholars.
